hypothesis: W-R22/23 mask-aware classification exploited exact all-zero erasure markers. Holding fixed all model weights/training data, test whether the learned behavior survives other missing-value encodings that preserve observable local swap sites.
freeze: Freeze erasure representations, exact mask positions, input generator, new seed population, models and thresholds before first scientific use. No retrofitting marker interpretation.
training: Reuse W-R22 train() only on its immutable original development seeds240..255, each of four 16-weight+bias models trained on 1728 original examples/32 epochs. No development examples altered, zero retraining for unseen marker format.
encoding: For each erasure tick in the first N mask positions, replace all four observed candidate channels with (0,0,0,0), (255,255,255,255), or the candidate row from the immediately preceding timestep before any masking (carry_forward), respectively. Mask sites never touch anchor or swapped observations t11..14. After erasure, negative swaps tail positions10/11 or12/13. Positive and negative have identical candidate multiset and anchor.
classification: SENTINEL_INVARIANCE if maskaware_augmented accuracy >=0.85 for all 18 heldout cells and >=0.05 better than naive_augmented aggregate; FORMAT_SPECIFIC if all six zero-marker cells of maskaware_augmented >=0.85 but any of 12 alternative-marker cells <0.75; PARTIAL if zero cells >=0.85 and alt performance between conditions; NEGATIVE otherwise. Preserve per-cell confusion and all negatives.
controls: No change to four already-observed channel capacity or model weights
Same erasure sites for positive/negative and both swapped rows observable
No hidden missingness oracle supplied to existing source models
New disjoint heldout seeds never used in W-R22 or W-R23
Original first-use artifact and complete repository regression with exact SHA checks
claim_limit: Finite synthetic observation coding transfer, not raw language generalization.
